  How to Submit Public Comment

  Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of
  the following methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

  In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and
  submit it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3)
  minutes per person per item. At the Mayor’ s discretion, the time limit may be
  shortened to allow all speakers to address the City Council.

  Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the City’s website
  as noted below. Public Comment submitted electronically by 4:00 P.M. on the
  meeting day will be forwarded to the City Council before the meeting for their
  consideration but will not be read during the meeting. Comments submitted after
  4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Council but may not be received before the meeting.

  Website: Please submit your comments using the online public comment form at
  Public Comment.

MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 9, 2024
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Wu called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 11 :53
  A.M. on Saturday, November 9, 2024, in the Mission Playhouse, 320 South Mission Drive,
  San Gabriel, CA 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Eric Chan, Tony Ding, John R. Harrington, Vice Mayor
  Denise Menchaca and Mayor John Wu.
  Mayor Wu (left at 4:15 P.M.).
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Paul Early, Community Services Director Rebecca Perez,
  Community Services Assistant Director Matthew
  Morales-Stevens, Mission Playhouse Manager Chris
  Hulen, Playhouse Operations Supervisor Cleo De Orio,

I
  Playhouse Production Coordinator Ken Gonser and
  Front of House Coordinator Benji Kaufman

  1. STUDY SESSION

  A. SAN GABRIEL MISSION PLAYHOUSE STRATEGIC VISIONING WORKSHOP

  Arts Consulting Group facilitated a Strategic Visioning Workshop for the Playhouse
  to discuss and identify future plans for the Playhouse, its facilities, ongoing
  governance structure, and its future growth.

  There was no public comment.

  At City Manager Lazzaretto's invitation, presumptive Council Member-Elect Jorge
  Herrera Avila joined the discussion.
  Discussion included an analysis of the strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities
  within the Mission Playhouse (Playhouse), development of core values and
  priorities for the Playhouse, and outlining key ways in which work can be done
  toward accomplishing the priorities within the next two years. The discussions took

I  place within the large group of participants and smaller breakout groups. All
  discussions within the breakout groups were presented to the broader group in
  efforts to develop the items listed above.

  Direction was not provided by City Council since the primary goal was for the City
  Council and key stakeholders to provide feedback for the Arts Consulting Group
  to provide analysis and recommendations for staff review.

  2. ADJOURNMENT
